definitions.ask: Should an age-based reaper delete stale agent-index .bak backups?
definitions.why: A sase-zw gate already declined deleting backups, and no SASE code writes these files

choices.label: Backups get a human-action disk row and a gated one-time delete; nothing deletes them automatically
An age-based reaper deletes agent-index backups older than 30 days

definitions.ask: Remove the quiet-task-beads rule from the chezmoi config once the triage-volume fix lands?
definitions.why: The rule's own text says to remove it once the triage-volume fix is in

choices.label: Beads-tab toasts and sounds return once the human runs chezmoi apply
The rule stays, and the phase records per-bead volume for a later call
